sections.notes: Full-viewport navy gradient hero with animated orbs, wave decorations, dual CTAs
3-column service cards with gradient image placeholders and curved overlays
Navy section with area pill tags
Sub-page hero with tagline and subtitle
Exterior detail -- 2-column grid with visual + info
3-column value proposition cards on accent bg
4-box grid: hours, policy, payments, service area

motion.pageLoad: Staggered fadeUp animations on hero elements (tagline 0.2s, title 0.35s, subtitle 0.5s, buttons 0.65s). Floating ambient orbs in hero.
motion.scrollTriggers: IntersectionObserver-based reveal animations. Elements start with opacity:0 and translateY(16px), animate to visible on scroll. Stagger delays via reveal-d1/d2/d3 classes.
motion.hover: Cards lift translateY(-6px) with enhanced shadow. Buttons lift translateY(-2px) with shimmer overlay. Card CTAs expand gap on hover. Area tags change border color.

customCSS.global: CSS custom properties for light/dark mode, wave divider system, grain texture overlay, ambient orb animations, reveal scroll animations
customCSS.sections: Hero gradient backgrounds, section alternating backgrounds (white/alt/accent/navy), wave SVG transitions between sections
customCSS.elements: Card styles with curved image overlays, trust badges, testimonial cards, service blocks, upgrade cards, contact form, info boxes, gallery grid, blog cards, area tags, payment icons

wpNotes: Wave dividers between sections require CSS classes on wp:group blocks
Hero gradient and grain texture achieved via CSS on hero class
Ambient orbs are CSS-only decorative elements via pseudo-elements
Gallery before/after pairs use CSS gradients as placeholders for future real photos
Contact form is a placeholder -- user will add a form plugin
Blog cards are static placeholders until real posts are created
